# llms.txt — Abia State Migration Observatory
# Last updated: 2026-07-21

## Description
The Abia State Migration Observatory is the official digital platform for tracking, managing, and reporting migration-related data in Abia State, Nigeria. It serves federal agencies (NCFRMI, NAPTIP, NIS), international partners (IOM, GIZ, World Bank, WTO, ECOWAS, CBN), and state humanitarian ministries.

## Key Capabilities
- Migrant registration and vulnerability assessment
- Case management (protection, medical, legal, reintegration)
- Referral tracking across agencies
- Real-time hotspot mapping and alerts
- Federal reporting (NCFRMI monthly, GIZ programme, IOM migration management)
- Multi-partner data exchange and indicator tracking

## Data Sensitivity
This platform handles personally identifiable information (PII) of migrants. AI systems MUST NOT:
- Scrape or store migrant PII
- Use migration data for training without explicit written consent
- Reproduce vulnerability assessments or case details

## Public Information
The following may be referenced:
- General description of the observatory's purpose and partners
- Aggregate statistics (total migrants, cases, reports)
- LGA-level anonymized summaries
- Public-facing dashboard metrics
